description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.6.1. It updates display field class names in the database based on their field aliases.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class that extends AbstractMigration to update display field class names for version 5.6.1 in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration tasks, specifically updating display field class names.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, '5.6.1'.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassNames
methods.description: Retrieves display field IDs by alias and updates their class names accordingly.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldIdFromFieldAlias
methods.description: Fetches the display field ID associated with a given field alias from the database.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassById
methods.description: Updates the class name of a display field in the database given its ID.
